rationale: The stock is showing signs of exhaustion after a massive intraday recovery, failing to break above the $69.10 high and printing a bearish rejection candle on high volume. With only 27 minutes left in the session and significant negative fundamental sentiment regarding debt obligations, the risk of a late-day profit-taking sell-off outweighs the momentum of the recovery. The invalidation is placed just above the session high to capture a potential failure to reclaim that level.
